monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral plant-support system that moves a purchase-ready reader through the real job, room and access map, support-type tradeoffs, complete load path, three-candidate comparison, total first-cycle cost, dry acceptance test, returns, and a valid no-purchase exit. No merchant, product, live price, rating, discount, availability, fabricated test, product image, or paid conclusion was added.

image_qa.note: Both new pages deliberately use text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets rather than stock, generated, patient, treatment, plant, merchant, or product imagery. No existing image was changed, and no ambiguous exact-product visual or licensing claim was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is seven days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, about 0.4% CTR, and average position 24.1. The only meaningful non-legal volume signal—Blue Dream, 33 impressions and zero clicks—was already materially reinforced on November 17, so repeating that cluster would violate the diversity rule. The unused 510-versus-disposable query had only two impressions at position 12; Delaware had two impressions and one click; remaining rows were single impressions or irrelevant. Those signals were deliberately ignored as too weak, already served, or duplicative. No item in this batch is labeled Data-led; the report informed the decision to preserve breadth instead of manufacturing another thin query variation.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready cut-down or quit support planner grounded in current CDC, SAMHSA, and VA sources, with an observable-goal map, seven-field baseline, warning-signal evidence table, support sequence, withdrawal handoff, hard safety gates, and treatment routes. Reciprocal links connect it to the established withdrawal, clinician-conversation, driving-safety, and mental-health cluster. Added a public external-source transport and behavior-change boundary to the editorial policy and release audit. No outreach was sent and no speculative outreach target was logged.
